name: Sar'theris Strand
summary: Sar'theris Strand forms the western coastline of Desolace, fronting the Veiled Sea. In stark contrast to the barren, grey inland wastes, the shore is sunny and grassy, though it remains perilous due to prowling naga, sea giants, and makrura.

sections.title: A Green Edge on a Grey Waste
sections.body: Running the length of western Desolace, Sar'theris Strand offers a bizarre respite from the ash and dust of the inland plains. Here, the clifftops and beaches are bright and green. Yet the strand is far from welcoming: serpentine naga patrol the surf alongside towering sea giants and territorial makrura. Shipwrecks litter the shoals, including the ruined Karnitol vessel to the north and small shattered skiffs beneath the towers of Ethel Rethor, proving the sea is as treacherous as the shore.

sections.title: Wreckage and Rare Waters
sections.body: Beyond the constant threat of naga and giants, the waters off the strand are known among seasoned travelers for their peculiar bounties. The jagged coastal shallows conceal salvage from lost expeditions and merchant ventures, while the deep surf is home to rare marine wildlife, notably the prized Sar'theris Striker fish sought out by master fishermen across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is Sar'theris Strand green when the rest of Desolace is dead?
faq.answer: The coastline is sunny and grassy in contrast to the barren, grey interior of Desolace. The source does not explain why this contrast persists.

aliases: what monsters are on the strand
faq.answer: The strand is dominated by the amphibious Slitherblade naga, wandering sea giants, and scuttling makrura. Travelers must constantly watch the surf, as patrols roam close to the water's edge.

faq.q: What shipwrecks lie along the shore?
faq.answer: The Karnitol Shipwreck sits off the northern waters of the strand, while smaller vessels lie smashed on the beach bluffs beneath the ruined elven towers of Ethel Rethor.

faq.q: Why do fishermen seek out Sar'theris Strand?
faq.answer: The coastal waters here are the exclusive home of the Sar'theris Striker, an elusive fish recognized by renowned angler Nat Pagle as one of the ultimate tests of fishing mastery.

angles.text: The strand's shores and surrounding waters offer rich marine game, including makrura and rare ocean fish, though cooking fires must be lit under the constant watch of prowling naga.
